title: Fear & Hunger
provenance: Reported by cassLaffan (highball-db#1099, 2026-11-09), Apple M1, macOS 26.6.2, Highball 0.10.26, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, DXMT, rated 4 of 5 after 24 minutes: some lag and stuttering, compared with the reporter's Windows machine. Fine where reaction time doesn't matter, but at some points the stutter can change the outcome of a run. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Playable on an M1 with DXMT on the default engine (r28), with some lag and stutter that can matter in tense moments.

knownIssues.symptom: Lag and stuttering now and then, enough to change the outcome of a run at times (M1, DXMT, Wine 10 r28)
